spans.s:
ádha (ádhā, 248a), Vedic adv. expressing a
sequence: then, so, 79^8; so then, 89^18;
adha yad, just then when, 76^14; (then,
i. e. besides, i. e.) and, 77^18, 78^6. [1104^3:
cf. átha.]

adhamá [525], a. lowest; worst. [cf. adhas
and 474: cf. Lat. infimus, ‘lowest.’]

ádhara [525], a. lower. [cf. adhas and
474: cf. Lat. inferus, ‘lower’; Eng. under.]

adhaḥ-śāyin, a. lying low, i. e. sleeping
on the ground.

adhástāt, adv. below; as prep., w. gen.
[1130], under. [adhas, 1100b.]
